articles.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
articles.snippet: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

articles.title: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
articles.snippet: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East.

articles.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
articles.snippet: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 as oil prices hit six-month high
articles.snippet: Brent crude oil surged above $116 per barrel for the first time since late April.

articles.title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history
articles.snippet: Previous bitcoin bear-market lows followed U.S. midterms, but this year’s recovery raises the possibility that the bottom arrived months earlier.
